title: Molto bella!
body: Veramente una bella app rispetto ad altre che ho usato in passato! Mi sto trovando molto bene! Sarebbe bello secondo me se ci fosse un “festeggiamento” al completamento di tutte le habit giornaliere, un segnale da parte dell’app quando riesci a finire tutto. Inoltre purtroppo non sto riuscendo ad installarla sull’Apple Watch ma anche quello mi piacerebbe, in ogni caso fin’ora la migliore che ho usato
author: Rrr2595

title: Good app
body: Good app but just 2 abit to select is a bit low, so I suggest something like 3
author: Victor_Bosmani1010

title: [Updated] Complete and easy to use
body: Thanks to the devs for adding the widgets!
author: PhilLakeMajor

title: Semplicemente il migliore
body: Negli ultimi mesi avrò provato circa una decina di app per tracciare le abitudini e questa fa tutto ciò che ho sempre cercato, con un'interfaccia grafica bella e funzionale. Peccato per l'abbonamento ma sono felice di supportare lo sviluppo di applicazioni del genere; aiutano davvero a essere costanti!
author: Mr Rager 3

title: Add widgets please!
body: I love this app, but I want to see the widget with my Habit list in the home screen to easily mark them
author: twammatuna

title: The best habits tracking out there
body: I tried many apps before sticking with one. This is very intuitive and it has an amazing design, having everything is needed! The search for “the tracking app” ends here for me 😎 congrats to the indie dev who built this!
author: frankievaz

title: Best habit tracker app so far
body: Just love it, maybe a little too pricey but I’m ok with the free tier
author: DovivoD

title: Awesome
body: Love the app very practical, but i wish that without the premium we could get more to do thingies
author: noedda

title: What I was looking for
body: This app is simple yet it has everything I am looking for. The developer often release updates. I have bought the premium version because I am really enjoying it. I suggest a yearly vision with all the habits, one row for any habit and 365 columns.
author: Marta Murtas

title: Perfect
body: Honestly I think I tried all of the habit tracking apps I could find and this is the only one that was exactly the way I wanted it. Also I was able to go pro by paying once instead of a subscription, which is really good for me. I don’t like subscriptions. It’s very simple but that’s what I was looking for, no useless complicated features, just the ones I needed.
author: JakieChaaan
